messages:
Alex R.: FYI customer hitting repeated WS reconnects + partial frames after a NAT idle-close. client logs show: `FRAME_PARTIAL -> connection closed by remote` then client immediately reconnects and resends last batch -> duplicate inference work and billing surge.
Priya M.: any correlation with our ws-idle-timeout rollout last week? we shortened keepalive to 30s in EU to free sockets.
Alex R.: yes, spike started about 2h after that rollout. aggregate: ~450 reconnects/min for a handful of tenants.
Theo P.: sample trace from edge:
```
[edge] recv: 0x1 (text) len=1024 flag=FIN=false
[edge] client idle detected -> FIN sent by NAT
[client] sees abrupt close -> reconnect (no resume support) -> resubmit payload
[server] duplicate job created -> billing event
```
Sam (Ops): console telemetry currently shows socket_closed_total but not "partial-frame-before-close". we need a new metric `ws_partial_frame_close_total` and a tag for `idle_vs_rst`.
Priya M.: we should also show per-route sticky TTL vs keepalive window in the console so product can tune. users are getting confused by "why did my long-running websocket close at 30s". UX: add an inline hint on the route config: "Idle-close is enforced at the edge; increase keepalive to avoid mid-frame closes".
Alex R.: implementation plan: 1) add `ws_partial_frame_close_total{reason=\"idle\"|\"rst\"}` 2) add alert: rate(ws_partial_frame_close_total[5m]) by (tenant) > 5 -> p1 3) add dashboard tile with side-by-side `ws_idle_close_count` and `route.keepalive_seconds` for quick ops correlation.
Theo P.: runtime mitigation: accept a short grace for mid-frame continuation if we see a SYN or resume within 500ms (tunable). downside: increases socket lifetime and may interfere with autoscale. Alternative: server send `close-with-retry` code so client knows to wait and resume instead of immediate replay.
Sam (Ops): prefer protocol-level answer: send `WS-CLOSE: 4409 reopen-with-resume` (invent example) so client libs can backoff and attempt resume instead of replay. need spec + client lib change. ops can ship server header first (feature-flag) to start.
Priya M.: Console needs a rollout UX: feature flag `ws.close_hint.resume` with tenant toggle + gradual % rollout. Add admin UI to show which tenants have it and recent acceptance rate.
Alex R.: PromQL for new panel: `sum by(tenant)(rate(ws_partial_frame_close_total[5m]))` and acceptance rate: `sum(rate(ws_close_hint_sent_total[5m])) / sum(rate(ws_close_hint_accepted_total[5m]))` — show as % on tenant card.
Theo P.: will prototype server close hint and a small extension to the client lib to handle `4409` and attempt resume-with-delay. Backwards compatible: only take effect if client advertises support.
Sam (Ops): I'll add the alert and dashboard. what SLA for paging? p1 if > 5/min sustained for 10m for any prod tenant.
deploy-bot: feature flag created: ws.close_hint.resume -> default=off -> rollout=0%
Priya M.: Console change request filed (CR-1198): add tenant toggle, percent rollout slider, and a small info bubble explaining tradeoffs. Link to CR in thread.
Alex R.: one more ask: emit a trace span when we accept a resume-with-delay so the console trace links to the resumed session. otherwise it's hard to reconcile duplicate billing events.
Sam (Ops): +1 for trace span. also include route and edge-id in metric labels.
Theo P.: ETA: server PR today (opt-in behind flag), client lib PR tomorrow. I'll add a short README for implementers.
Priya M.: UX: avoid showing "errors" in tenant UI for expected closes; show them as recommendations: "Consider increasing keepalive" instead of marking unhealthy.
Alex R.: thumbs? :thumbsup:
Priya M.: :thumbsup:
Sam (Ops): :+1:
Theo P.: PR in 2h, pinged client-lib owners.
console-bot: CR-1198 added to backlog board -> assigned to Priya M.
Alex R.: thanks all, will follow up with dashboards + raw logs in the ops runbook.
